# Tool catalog

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build.py from data/tools.json. Edit the JSON, not this file. -->

67 tools across 10 categories. Snapshot: October 2026 — **licenses, ownership and features change; verify before adopting.** Use the [interactive explorer](../artifacts/landscape-explorer.html) to filter.

`OTel` = ingests/emits OpenTelemetry (Yes / Partial / N/A).

## Instrumentation & standards

| Tool | Model | License | What it does | Strengths | Watch-outs | OTel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [OpenTelemetry (GenAI semconv)](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/gen-ai/) | Standard / OSS | Apache-2.0 | Vendor-neutral spec, SDKs and Collector; `gen_ai.*` conventions (Development). | The portability layer | GenAI conventions not yet stable | Yes |
| [OpenInference](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference) | Spec / OSS | Apache-2.0 | Semantic conventions + instrumentors for LLM frameworks (used by Phoenix). | Rich span kinds for RAG/agents | Overlaps with OTel GenAI | Yes |
| [OpenLLMetry (Traceloop)](https://github.com/traceloop/openllmetry) | OSS | Apache-2.0 | OTel instrumentation for LLM providers, vector DBs, frameworks. | Broad auto-instrumentation | — | Yes |
| [OpenTelemetry Collector](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/collector/) | OSS | Apache-2.0 | Pipeline for receive/process/export: redaction, tail sampling, spanmetrics. | Keeps you vendor-neutral | Operate it | Yes |
